**You meet the eligibility criteria for all eight DVUT research grants (CGPA 9.5 ≥ each grant’s minimum, Year 3, CS department) [Doc: Research Grant Policy 2026‑27 §2]; however only the grants whose status is **open** can be applied for now.**  

| Grant (code) | Title | Application deadline | Status |
|--------------|-------------------------------|----------------------|--------|
| GR‑AI‑01 | AI for Social Good Research Fellowship | 20 Dec 2026 | open |
| GR‑ML‑02 | Undergraduate Machine Learning Research Assistantship | 10 Jan 2027 | open |
| GR‑CY‑03 | Cybersecurity Research Scholarship | 31 Jan 2027 | open |
| GR‑SUS‑08 | Sustainability & Green Computing Grant | 28 Feb 2027 | open |
| GR‑ROB‑12 | Autonomous Robotics Research Grant | 31 Dec 2026 | closed |
| GR‑HW‑06 | Hardware Hackathon Seed Fund | 15 Dec 2026 | closed |
| GR‑HC‑10 | HealthTech Innovation Grant | 15 Mar 2027 | upcoming (opens 05 Jan 2027) |
| GR‑SP‑14 | Summer Research Internship Stipend | 31 Mar 2027 | upcoming (opens 01 Dec 2026) |

*Open grants can be applied for now; closed grants no longer accept applications, and upcoming grants can be applied for after their opening date [Doc: Research Grant Policy 2026‑27 §2].*  

**Next steps:** prepare the required documents listed for each grant (e.g., research proposal, grade card, no‑dues certificate for GR‑CY‑03) and submit before the respective deadline.
sql: SELECT grant_code, title, amount, application_open, application_deadline, status FROM grants WHERE grant_code = ANY(ARRAY['GR-AI-01', 'GR-CY-03', 'GR-ML-02', 'GR-SUS-08', 'GR-ROB-12', 'GR-SP-14', 'GR-HC-10', 'GR-HW-06']) ORDER BY application_deadline
